newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Gotesco to raise capital to 2.5 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Gotesco to raise capital to 2.5 bln pesos.

text.p: Philippines' Gotesco Land Inc said on Monday its board had approved a resolution raising its authorised capital to 2.5 billion pesos from the present 1.0 billion pesos.
Corporate secretary Amado Santiago told the Philippine Stock Exchange it planned to increase the par value of each share to one peso from one centavo apiece.
The board also approved several property acquisitions which would beef up its real estate holdings. Gotesco was recently converted into a real estate company from being a mining company.

Santiago said the company bought 100 percent stake each in three resorts just south of Manila. One of them will be developed into a marina and leisure complex with a theme park, casino and a 250-room hotel.
Gotesco also entered into a joint venture agreement to build a 36-golf course in the central island of Cebu.
It had also acquired a 609,325 square metre lot for its low-cost housing project just north of Manila.
All the acquisitions are yet to be approved by stockholders due to meet on December 18.
